snippet.title: DACHstudio Jigsaw Puzzle Box | puzzle fun with 16 up to 728 pieces 🧩 | OFFICIAL LAUNCH TRAILER
snippet.description:
DACHstudio Jigsaw Puzzle Box is a free to play relaxing experience with buy able DLC's from the amazing DACHstudio members.

Beautifully hand drawn and sometimes even traditionally drawn artworks from the DACHstudio members for you to puzzle. Multiple difficulties from 16 up to 728 pieces 🧩 for everyone to enjoy.

Play on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2833590/DACHstudio_Puzzle_Box/
Links on SpielmannSpiel: https://spielmannspiel.com/dachstudio-jigsaw-puzzle-box
Megumi M: https://megumi-m.die-kreativberatung.de/
DACHstudio: https://dachstudio.art/
EDENstreet: https://edenstreet.de/
